adequacy_evidence.quote: **Scientific adequacy: supported.** The reported lack of whole-brain-corrected vmPFC support follows a suitable one-sample group analysis of all 54 maps and a positive, whole-brain max-T permutation test. The report states what the COPEs measure, gives uncertainty, and avoids treating a null result as proof of no effect.

hypothesis_conclusion.quote: The analysis does not support a positive vmPFC effect after whole-brain correction.
